summary: A comprehensive hospital management system covering patient registration, appointment scheduling, medical records, billing, pharmacy, lab, ward management, and reporting. Built with a microservice-ready layered architecture.

sprints.name: Sprint 1 – Core Infrastructure & Auth
sprints.goal: Stand up the backend API skeleton, database schema, and user authentication for staff and patients.

sprints.name: Sprint 2 – Patient & Appointment Management
sprints.goal: Enable patient registration, profile management, and doctor appointment booking and scheduling.

sprints.name: Sprint 3 – Medical Records & Billing
sprints.goal: Implement electronic health records (EHR), prescription management, and invoicing/billing.

sprints.name: Sprint 4 – Pharmacy, Lab & Reporting
sprints.goal: Add pharmacy inventory, lab test ordering, result tracking, and admin analytics dashboard.

tasks.title: Database schema design
tasks.description: Design and implement the relational schema for patients, staff, appointments, medical records, billing, pharmacy and lab tables using SQLAlchemy 2.0 migrations.

tasks.title: Staff authentication & RBAC
tasks.description: Implement JWT-based login for doctors, nurses, receptionists and admins. Role-based access control middleware.

tasks.title: Patient registration API
tasks.description: REST endpoints to register, update, search and deactivate patient profiles. Includes duplicate detection by NHI number.

tasks.title: Doctor & department management
tasks.description: CRUD for doctors, departments, specialisations, and working-hour schedules. Supports assigning doctors to wards.

tasks.title: Appointment scheduling engine
tasks.description: Allow patients to book appointments. Conflict detection, waiting-list, cancellation, reminder notifications via email.

tasks.title: Frontend – patient portal
tasks.description: React pages for patient self-registration, appointment booking, and viewing upcoming visits.

tasks.title: Electronic health records (EHR) API
tasks.description: Create, read, and update patient visit notes, diagnoses (ICD-10 codes), vital signs, and allergies. Only the attending doctor may write.

tasks.title: Prescription management
tasks.description: Doctors prescribe medications; system checks drug interactions, sends to pharmacy queue. Pharmacist confirms dispensed.

tasks.title: Billing & invoice generation
tasks.description: Auto-generate itemised invoices from visit, procedures, and prescriptions. Support partial payment and insurance claim codes.

tasks.title: Frontend – doctor & nurse dashboard
tasks.description: React dashboard for doctors: today's appointments, patient queue, EHR writing, prescription submission.

tasks.title: Pharmacy inventory management
tasks.description: Track drug stock levels, expiry dates, supplier orders, reorder alerts. Integrated with prescription queue.

tasks.title: Lab test ordering & results
tasks.description: Doctor orders lab tests; lab technician uploads results (PDF or structured). Results linked to patient EHR.

tasks.title: Ward & bed management
tasks.description: Track ward occupancy, assign beds to admitted patients, discharge process, and ward transfer logging.

tasks.title: Admin analytics dashboard
tasks.description: Charts: daily admissions, revenue trend, bed occupancy rate, appointment no-shows, top diagnoses. Exportable to CSV.

tasks.title: End-to-end testing & deployment
tasks.description: Write Pytest integration tests for all critical paths. Dockerise backend and frontend. CI pipeline and staging deploy.
